title: Honesty-Aware Multi-Agent Framework for High-Fidelity Synthetic Data Generation in Digital Psychiatric Intake Doctor-Patient Interactions
reasoning: The paper focuses on clinical data generation and diagnostic accuracy by modeling patient honesty and deception behaviors (concealment and exaggeration). While honesty is a moral concept, the work is centered on clinical simulation realism and psychiatric assessment performance rather than evaluating religious beliefs, moral frameworks, or ethical reasoning.
